info.title: Mobile User Spring Boot API
info.description: Demo checkout. Session authentication with HttpOnly JSESSIONID. GET /api/csrf first; send its token as X-XSRF-TOKEN on every POST/PATCH/DELETE, including login. Fetch a fresh token after login. Swagger UI handles the CSRF cookie automatically. Validation: 422; unauthenticated: 401; CSRF: 403; missing or foreign resources: 404; conflicting email, order state, reviewed total or idempotency key: 409. All money is decimal USD. No real payments.

post.description: Atomically locks the account and products, checks owned checkout address/test card, compares required expected_total with BigDecimal total, snapshots prices, creates tracking and clears cart. Retry an identical submission_key to retrieve the same order. Notifications happen after commit; failures never undo checkout. With a selected quote, expected_total includes shipping; label creation is a separate test-only operation.

200.description: Successful JSON response. Errors use the documented HTTP status and success:false.

expected_total.description: Required total last reviewed by the customer. A changed total returns 409 without creating an order.

submission_key.description: Unique key per reviewed checkout. Retain for retries; identical retries return the same order without another email. Different details with a used key return 409.

delivery_quote_id.description: Owned unexpired quote from /api/shipping/rates. Required with Shippo enabled; must match address and cart.

patch.description: Only the owner can update an active order, and only while its status is Processing. Saved address IDs come from addresses_set_b on the order response. Cancelled and dispatched orders cannot be changed. The change is saved to the order before sending a confirmation email with previous/new addresses and tracking. Re-saving the same address returns changed:false and does not send another notification. Email failure does not undo the saved change.

200.description: Successful JSON response. Errors use the documented HTTP status and success:false.

changed.description: False when the order already uses this saved address.

email_sent.description: Whether the confirmation email was accepted by the local SMTP inbox.
